title: CHIP modulates Wnt/beta-catenin signalling in colorectal cancer through proteasomal degradation of DDX17.
authors: Kumar, Sunny; Ghosh, Sayani; Basu, Malini; Ghosh, Mrinal K
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular cell research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CHIP通过泛素化降解DDX17调控Wnt/β-catenin信号通路，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，仅分子对接辅助验证，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The C-terminus of Hsc70-interacting protein (CHIP), an E3 ubiquitin ligase, plays a pivotal role in cellular protein homeostasis by targeting client proteins for proteasomal degradation. DEAD-box RNA helicase DDX17 is a key regulator of RNA metabolism and has been implicated in various cancer-related processes, including Wnt/beta-catenin signalling and EMT. In this study, we uncover a novel regulatory axis involving CHIP and DDX17 responsible for modulation of Wnt/beta-catenin signalling in colorectal cancer (CRC). Bioinformatic analyses of CPTAC database and immunohistochemical analysis of clinical samples revealed a significant negative correlation between CHIP and DDX17. By using immunoprecipitation-mass spectrometry we have identified DDX17 as a high-confidence interacting partner of CHIP, which was validated through co-immunoprecipitation, domain-mapping, immunocytochemistry, and molecular docking studies, pinpointing the TPR domain of CHIP is essential for this interaction. Mechanistically, CHIP overexpression led to accelerated degradation of DDX17, resulting in reduced beta-catenin mRNA stability, leading to the suppression of Wnt/beta-catenin signalling that results in G1 arrest and decreasing proliferation and EMT. Conversely, CHIP knockdown stabilized DDX17, hence promoting beta-catenin signalling that leads to oncogenic phenotype. Our results suggest that CHIP exerts a tumor-suppressive phenotype in CRC by destruction of DDX17, thereby attenuating beta-catenin-driven oncogenic processes. Altogether, this study identifies a novel "CHIP-DDX17-beta-catenin" axis as a critical regulatory mechanism in CRC.
abstract_zh: Hsc70相互作用蛋白的C末端（CHIP），一种E3泛素连接酶，通过靶向客户蛋白进行蛋白酶体降解，在细胞蛋白质稳态中发挥关键作用。DEAD-box RNA解旋酶DDX17是RNA代谢的关键调控因子，并已涉及多种癌症相关过程，包括Wnt/β-catenin信号传导和上皮-间质转化（EMT）。在本研究中，我们揭示了一个涉及CHIP和DDX17的新型调控轴，该轴负责调节结直肠癌（CRC）中的Wnt/β-catenin信号传导。对CPTAC数据库的生物信息学分析及临床样本的免疫组织化学分析显示，CHIP与DDX17之间存在显著的负相关。通过使用免疫沉淀-质谱联用技术，我们鉴定DDX17为CHIP的高置信度相互作用伙伴，并通过共免疫沉淀、结构域定位、免疫细胞化学和分子对接研究进行了验证，指出CHIP的TPR结构域对此相互作用至关重要。机制上，CHIP过表达导致DDX17加速降解，进而降低β-catenin mRNA稳定性，抑制Wnt/β-catenin信号传导，从而引起G1期阻滞并减少增殖和EMT。相反，CHIP敲低稳定了DDX17，从而促进β-catenin信号传导，导致致癌表型。我们的结果表明，CHIP通过破坏DDX17在CRC中发挥肿瘤抑制表型，从而减弱β-catenin驱动的致癌过程。总之，本研究确定了“CHIP-DDX17-β-catenin”轴作为CRC中的关键调控机制。
